slides.title: Social Simulations: from Agent-Based Modeling to Digital Twins
slides.highlight: This work traces the shift from rule-based agent models to LLM-enhanced simulations and Social Digital Twins, providing a foundation for the meso- and societal-scale simulation goals of MIMIC.

card.one_liner: A survey tracing the evolution of social simulations from rule-based agent modeling to LLM-enhanced digital twins.
card.key_idea: Progresses from classical ABMs (explicit rules) to LLM-ABMs (natural language reasoning) and Social Digital Twins (data-driven, high-fidelity replicas of specific real-world socio-technical systems).
card.evaluation: Not clearly stated; the text is a conceptual survey reviewing existing literature and frameworks rather than a new empirical experiment.
card.limitation: High sensitivity to prompt design, potential for model biases, and the risk of overfitting realism over general epistemic validity.

slides.title: NeuraFrame Studio Launches Embodied AI Memory Layer
slides.tldr: EMBODIED AI MEMORY LAYER FOR ROBOTS
slides.highlight: NeuraFrame Studio has introduced a memory layer that enables robots to learn without onboard AI models, which is relevant to RwB's focus on embodied social robots and AI-mediated learning.

slides.title: UBTech Launches Hyper-Real Humanoid Robots for Lonely People
slides.highlight: UBTech has introduced hyper-real humanoid robots designed to assist lonely individuals, providing a relevant case for RwB's focus on embodied social robots.

slides.title: Knowing You at First Glance: Inferring Apparent Personality from Faces
slides.tldr: FACIAL PERSONALITY INFERENCE FOR EMBODIED AGENTS
slides.highlight: The GlanceFace framework enables embodied agents to infer apparent personality from facial images, supporting adaptive initial interaction strategies. This is relevant to RwB's focus on human-robot interaction and embodied social robots.

card.one_liner: GlanceFace infers perceived MBTI personality types from facial images using vision-language model semantic priors.
card.key_idea: Combines a Semantic-Enhanced Facial Representation module for capturing subtle cues with an uncertainty-aware learning strategy to handle noisy, subjective personality annotations.
card.evaluation: Evaluated on MBTI benchmarks using Top-K accuracy, F1, and AUC; outperformed baselines like ArcFace and AdaFace at person and image levels.
card.limitation: Predicts perceived impressions rather than intrinsic personality; risks include demographic bias, privacy concerns, and potential misuse in profiling.

slides.title: CF-Net: Conflict Fusion with Speaker Normalisation and Certainty Weighting for Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition
slides.highlight: CF-Net uses a ConflictFusion module to detect cross-modal incongruence and speaker normalization to reduce identity leakage, supporting HyECHO's goals in multimodal social perception and identity recognition.

card.one_liner: CF-Net recognizes ambivalence and hesitancy by explicitly modeling cross-modal incongruence using frozen multimodal backbones.
card.key_idea: Uses ConflictFusion (pairwise absolute-difference features), per-speaker normalization to remove identity offsets, and certainty-weighted focal loss with an auxiliary regression head to handle annotation ambiguity.
card.evaluation: Evaluated on the BAH dataset; achieved 0.7155 validation Macro F1 and 0.7364 private test Macro F1, outperforming previous 10th ABAW challenge results.
card.limitation: Relies on frozen backbones; future work suggests selective fine-tuning and replacing fixed fusion with learned cross-modal attention.

slides.title: Catch, Throw, Repeat: Planning for Human-Robot Partner Juggling
slides.highlight: This work presents a real-time planning and control architecture for synchronized multi-ball juggling, contributing to the advancement of physical human-robot interaction relevant to RwB.

card.one_liner: A real-time planning system enabling a robot to perform synchronized multi-ball partner juggling with humans.
card.key_idea: Integrates predictive ball tracking, adaptive online trajectory optimization via multiple-shooting, and state-machine-based coordination logic to manage catch-and-throw decisions in real-time.
card.evaluation: User study with 8 participants (beginner to expert); achieved 3-ball cascades and 100% success in single-ball trials. Results exceed previous records.
card.limitation: Performance is constrained by timing pressure at high ball counts and lack of explicit inter-ball collision avoidance.

slides.title: CausalGraphX: A Counterfactual Graph Neural Network Framework for Explainable Systemic Risk Assessment
slides.tldr: EXPLAINABLE SYSTEMIC RISK ASSESSMENT VIA COUNTERFACTUAL GNNs
slides.highlight: CausalGraphX integrates Graph Neural Networks with counterfactual reasoning to model cascading defaults in financial networks. This is relevant to MIMIC's focus on societal-scale simulation and impact analysis of complex systems.

card.one_liner: CausalGraphX uses counterfactual GNNs to predict financial systemic risk and provide actionable, causal explanations.
card.key_idea: Integrates Graph Attention Networks with adversarial regularization to remove spurious correlations and an optimization-based generator to identify minimal feature changes that prevent cascading defaults.
card.evaluation: Tested on synthetic ER and BA networks using AUC, F1, and counterfactual metrics. Outperformed GCN, GAT, and DebtRank baselines.
card.limitation: Evaluation relies on synthetic datasets and simulators rather than real-world financial data.

slides.title: Conversational Tactile Data Interfaces: Co-Designing Accessible Data Experiences with Blind Users Using Refreshable Tactile Displays and Conversational AI
slides.tldr: CONVERSATIONAL TACTILE DATA INTERFACES FOR BLIND USERS
slides.highlight: This work explores the integration of refreshable tactile displays and conversational AI to support data visualization, contributing to HyECHO's interest in multimodal social perception and interaction.

card.one_liner: A co-designed interface combining refreshable tactile displays with LLM-powered conversational AI for accessible data visualization.
card.key_idea: Integrates a multi-line tactile display with an LLM agent using layered presentations, deictic touch-to-speech queries, and synchronized animated tactile highlights for spatial grounding.
card.evaluation: Iterative co-design with three blind or low-vision users over four workshops; used think-aloud methods and NASA-TLX for workload assessment.
card.limitation: Hardware constraints include low display resolution and pins that do not reliably actuate under finger pressure.

slides.title: Human-Robot Interaction in GenAI Architectures via the Agent-Client Protocol
slides.tldr: UNIFIED COMMUNICATION PROTOCOL FOR GENAI ROBOTIC HRI
slides.highlight: This work proposes a decoupled three-layer architecture using the Agent-Client Protocol to standardize human-robot interaction, supporting real-time observability and task interruption. This is relevant to RwB's focus on human-robot interaction and embodied AI orchestration.

card.one_liner: A decoupled three-layer robotic architecture using ACP and MCP to standardize human-robot interaction and execution.
card.key_idea: Combines the Agent-Client Protocol (ACP) for the HRI layer and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for the execution layer, separating user interfaces, cognitive orchestration, and physical control.
card.evaluation: Tested on 'Sancho' mobile robot with three heterogeneous interfaces; validated real-time HRI workflows with negligible protocol latency (<0.5% of total loop).
card.limitation: Lacks native support for continuous multimodal data streaming (e.g., live video) and asynchronous background telemetry.
